summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  **I did not edit anything.** I had a sub-agent read (read-only) the full watchlist path: `WatchlistPage.tsx`, `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`/`handlers.ts`, the auth middleware, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `App.tsx`/`useAuth.tsx`, and checked for localStorage/React Query caching. Findings below shape the plan.  ### What the investigation found The code, as it stands, looks correctly wired: - Watchlists are keyed by a `NOT NULL` `user_id` FK, every handler filters `WHERE user_id = X-User-Id`, no anonymous/default-watchlist
